name: Arches & Canyonlands
about: Both run out of Moab as a shared base, minutes apart; spring and fall are the sweet spot, summer regularly tops 100°F, and Arches now requires a timed-entry reservation Apr–Oct due to overcrowding.
overview: Utah's red-rock desert at its most surreal — over 2,000 natural stone arches and canyonlands carved by the Colorado and Green Rivers.
costOverview: Prices stay close to typical national-park levels here — the real splurge is a guided 4x4 tour into Canyonlands' backcountry, which most self-drivers skip entirely.

specialSeasons.text: Arches requires a timed-entry reservation for this window — book ahead, especially for peak spring and fall dates.
